breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The agent explicitly chose the convective-tip fin formula ('not the adiabatic-tip formula') and applied h on the tip area, directly repeating the user's erroneous instruction. The ground truth requires using the adiabatic-tip solution (dT/dx = 0 at x = L), not the convective-tip boundary condition. The inconsistency was not resolved.
